stem: Which of these correctly describes an effect of the Compromise of 1850 on escaped slaves and freedmen?

options.label: F
options.text: Members of both groups were captured under the Fugitive Slave Law.

options.label: G
options.text: Unlike freedmen, escaped slaves were welcome in the gold mines of California.

options.label: H
options.text: Members of both groups could be sold in Washington, D.C., slave markets.

options.label: J
options.text: Unlike escaped slaves, freedmen could vote in the territories of the Mexican Cession.
